title: TypeError: setup_class() takes exactly 1 positional argument (2 given)

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: problem that needs to be addressed

body:
Originally reported by: **Jason R. Coombs (BitBucket: [jaraco](http://bitbucket.org/jaraco), GitHub: [jaraco](http://github.com/jaraco))**

---

I have a test class with a setup_class classmethod:

```
class MyTest(object):
        @classmethod
        def setup_class(cls):
                if sys.version_info < (2, 6):
                        py.test.xfail('...')
```

([[/jaraco/hgtools/src/5e0fcf95bdc9/test/test_managers.py#cl-72|full source]])

When I run this test using pytest 2.2.3 on Python 3.2.2, I get an error:

```
=================================== ERRORS ====================================
____________ ERROR at setup of TestRelativePaths.test_nested_child ____________

self = <CallInfo when='setup' exception: setup_class() takes exactly 1 positional argument (2 given)>
func = <function <lambda> at 0x0000000002E1FDC8>, when = 'setup'

        #: context of invocation: one of "setup", "call",
        #: "teardown", "memocollect"
        self.when = when
        self.start = time.time()

            try:

        plugins = self.config._getmatchingplugins(self.fspath)

    def pcall(self, plugins, **kwargs):
        methods = self.hookrelay._pm.listattr(self.name, plugins=plugins)

colitem = <Function 'test_nested_child'>

    def prepare(self, colitem):
        """ setup objects along the collector chain to the test-method
                and teardown previously setup objects."""
        needed_collectors = colitem.listchain()
        self._teardown_towards(needed_collectors)

        # check if the last collection node has raised an error
        for col in self.stack:
            if hasattr(col, '_prepare_exc'):
                py.builtin._reraise(*col._prepare_exc)
        for col in needed_collectors[len(self.stack):]:
            self.stack.append(col)
            try:
>               col.setup()

C:\Python\lib\site-packages\pytest-2.2.3-py3.2.egg\_pytest\runner.py:345:
_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _

self = <Class 'TestRelativePaths'>

    def setup(self):
        setup_class = getattr(self.obj, 'setup_class', None)
        if setup_class is not None:
            setup_class = getattr(setup_class, 'im_func', setup_class)
>           setup_class(self.obj)
E           TypeError: setup_class() takes exactly 1 positional argument (2 given)

C:\Python\lib\site-packages\pytest-2.2.3-py3.2.egg\_pytest\python.py:314: TypeError
```

I suspect this error is due to the way methods are bound differently to their classes/instances in Python 3 than in Python 2.

I'll leave it to Holger to devise a patch, unless you would like me to draft something, then just ask.
